notes.title: New Update v17!
notes.content:
Heyo, my friends!!

Today, we just fixed a few small bugs regarding getting out of the ship and entering a whirlpool and being trapped without moving (on both the new Christmas Event map and also the Raid Boss map).

Thank you to Kayla❤ for submitting this bug. 

We have also adjusted the "Credits" page to let you know there is now a category for streamers on both Twitch and Kick!!

Thank YOU ALL for playing and your interest in "DEEP HORRORS OF FISHING"!

Merry Fishmas!!


-Necro-

notes.title: v12 "The Frozen Depths"
notes.content:
"As winter's grip tightens, the frozen seas awaken. Venture into the icy abyss, where the frost hides ancient horrors and unimaginable treasures. Face the Frostmaw Leviathan, outwit the Glacial Wyrm, and more as you try to survive the frozen embrace of creatures that defy nature itself. Beware—the cold isn't your only enemy."

Added new enemies to fight, a new area to explore, new gear to equip, new battleback and even another fashion item.

WE HOPE YOU ENJOY!

Keep Fishing, my friends!


-NecroCaticGames-

notes.title: v4 Update!
notes.content:
Hello there!!

Here are some of the changes: 

We have added controller configuration as well and keyboard configuration!! 

FULLSCREEN option added.

Way to turn down music and sound fx by 5 in options.

Options to change the color of window (in options).

We have also added new items including Lucky Fishing Shirt, Upgraded Power and Defense Rings, a new area and even a new fish!! 

We tweaked the rod shops, bait shops and whatever to be hold more items further in the game you get.

We added more save slots (up to 50 now!). 

We added REINFORCED FISHING ROD! 

We added SWEDISH WARGOAT as upcoming music by in CREDITS!

Thank you for playing,

-Necro-
